primitives.name: Customer-Surface Gating Policy
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## What shipped tonight ### Customer-surface gating - `apps/web/lib/performance/public-performance-policy.ts` — single source of truth for "can this surface show a performance number?".
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P': 'Performance exposure flag (dimensionless binary)', 'S': 'Surface visibility state (dimensionless binary)', 'R': 'Record eligibility rule (boolean)', 'T': 'Trust-safe vocabulary token set (set)'}
primitives.assumptions: Policy is deterministic, all surfaces must pass R before S can be true, T ensures brand safety.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P=1 but R=0, surface exposure fails.

layer2.mapping: The policy function defines a kernel of trust-safe data access, where P depends on R and T; it enables conditional rendering of performance metrics based on risk thresholds.

primitives.name: Jarvis Launch Observatory
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Jarvis Launch Observatory - `apps/web/lib/cockpit/jarvis.ts` — pure synthesizer producing `JarvisLaunchStatus` + 11 sectional health readouts + phase matrix + recommended actions.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'JLS': 'Jarvis Launch Status (enum)', 'H_i': 'Sectional health readout i (unitless)', 'PM': 'Phase matrix (matrix)', 'A': 'Recommended action set (set)'}
primitives.assumptions: All inputs are synchronous, JLS is derived from H_i, PM encodes temporal progression, A is minimal and actionable.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If any H_i < threshold, JLS transitions to RED.

layer2.mapping: The status synthesis mirrors a phase-space trajectory in a dynamical system, where each H_i represents a subsystem's stability and A corresponds to control feedback.

primitives.name: Historical Pick Observability
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Historical pick observability - `apps/web/lib/cockpit/history.ts` — pure eligibility evaluator (`evaluatePickEligibility`) + `buildHistoryCsv` for export.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'Pick eligibility (boolean)', 'C': 'CSV export flag (binary)', 'P_k': 'Pick k (indexed event)', 'F': 'Filter group (set)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each P_k has fixed eligibility criteria E, F supports filtering, C enables archival.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If E(P_k)=false, P_k excluded from history.

layer2.mapping: The evaluator forms a kernel of temporal consistency, ensuring only valid picks contribute to historical analysis; C provides a mechanism for external validation.
layer2.telemetry: Eligible pick records and export readiness

Within this, the 'flat ledger' of file changes constitutes a discrete-time state transition sequence. The customer-surface gating primitive enforces a binary constraint on data exposure, modeled as a conditional probability P(S=1|P=1 ∧ R=1 ∧ T=valid), where S is surface visibility, P is performance flag, R is eligibility, and T is trust vocabulary. The Jarvis observatory synthesizes a launch status from 11 health readouts, forming a vector field in a 12-dimensional space (including status itself), with actions derived from gradient descent toward a stable phase. Historical pick observability applies a pure eligibility filter E(P_k) to generate a time-ordered sequence of valid picks, enabling forensic analysis. All three primitives form a coherent triad: policy enforcement, real-time monitoring, and post-hoc auditability. Failure modes include policy leakage (when P=1 but R=0), status collapse (when H_i < threshold), and eligibility bypass (when E(P_k)=false but P_k appears in history).
